interpretation: A pass only establishes improved exact Float32 self-intersection counts for this local patch in the three pinned static LBS poses, with positive orientation and no changed vertex records. It does not establish bone clearance, accepted FEM state, general ROM, or physical qualification.
scope: Topology-only same-vertex candidate on source128. Source XYZ, vertex records, donor weights, bindings, and vertex IDs are byte-identical; only selected local face rows change. No physical/native qualification.

search.selection: second-round vertex-disjoint same-vertex flips on unmodified faces, prioritized at worst-quality faces then crossing witnesses; all candidate pairs rechecked against the full surface in native rest and three poses
